summary: The case involved multiple civil appeals arising from special leave petitions concerning land acquisition and compensation matters. The key issues included the interpretation of compensation entitlements and procedural compliance under the relevant land acquisition laws. The Court examined the principles of just compensation and adherence to statutory procedures. The appeals were filed by the Delhi Development Authority challenging orders related to compensation awarded to landowners.
legal_provisions_cited: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
final_judgment: Civil Appeals allowed with directions for de novo determination of compensation in accordance with law.
